svg.title: How Prisma Compute Keeps Time Accurate in Long-Running Applications
svg.desc: A drift drawing: the host paired clock read from /dev/ptp0 runs flat while the guest CLOCK_REALTIME of an awake microVM falls away from it, reaching about minus 82.5 ms after six hours at the measured average of 13.75 ms per hour. Prisma blog cover, 2026 brand, prism red Compute accent.
